{{Quote|Meanwhile, my suite is '''yours''' to feel at '''home''' in, Princess. '''Enjoy''' yourself-- and don't waste time looking for '''another''' way out. There '''isn't''' any!|Simon Greyshade|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 19">[[Star Wars (1977) 19|''Star Wars'' (1977) 19]]</ref>}}
The '''Executive Tower''' of [[The Wheel/Legends|The ''Wheel'']] was built into the central hub of the space station. It contained the office suite of the Administrator. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that position was occupied by [[Simon Greyshade]].
